svg.text: The Entrance Hall: the first six minutes
Eleven altars: three teach (the ghost shows, nothing is judged), eight are judged, the last is the Great Altar under the chandelier
the ghost shows a twin move
the trap: one pan only is refused
take the gems off both pans
the crystal on the right pan
the ghost shows the sharing bowls
mixed, the crystal on the right
the Great Altar: take, then share
T: taught (the ghost shows; not judged)
J: judged (one SkillShown event for g6.maths.equations)
Numbers are new every visit (the crystal weighs 1-8; at most 12-15 gems on a pan). 5:40: the chandelier blazes, the door opens onto the Sky Room.
